verdict.rationale: Algolia's llms.txt lists 'AI Search (NeuralSearch) - Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search' as part of a hosted platform offering 'AI-powered semantic' search. That suggests vectorization is handled on Algolia's side. No evidence explicitly says Algolia embeds documents and queries for you, rather than you supplying your own vectors. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of managed or built-in embedding of records and queries, embedder model choice or configuration, setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
